title: How to Cure Aging – During Your Lifetime?
summary: A Kurzgesagt animated explainer on whether aging could be cured within our lifetimes, made with Lifespan.io and the LEAF foundation. It introduces the idea of treating aging as a medical problem.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible introduction to longevity research that changed some commenters' views.

quote.text: Yes this is a great introduction into the topic.
